lines.zh: 我慢慢走过峡谷的碎石
lines.en: I cross the canyon scree slowly.
My steps fall heavy and slow.
Slabs ring under my feet.
Head low, I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 我的肩很宽，卡在石缝里
lines.en: My shoulders are wide and wedge in the gaps.
My arms swing at my sides.
The canyon walls rise high on both sides.
I step across a dry gully.
Every step, I pause a moment.
My shadow trails long behind.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩壁走，避开风口
lines.en: I follow the wall, out of the wind.
Gravel scatters under my feet.
I stand in the canyon's middle, still.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在石壁间回响
lines.en: My breathing echoes off the walls.
The walls are pale grey, like bone.
I lift a hand and let it drop.

lines.zh: 这身壳很硬，动起来费劲
lines.en: This shell is hard and hard to move.
I tilt my head and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 有一块石头从上面掉下来
lines.en: A stone falls from above.
I look up for a long while.
My fingers spread one by one.
Nothing else lives in this canyon.
I turn my head, very slowly.
You're standing at the canyon mouth.

lines.zh: 我的壳在阳光下像石头
lines.en: My shell looks like stone in the sun.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在岩壁上，很长。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches long on the canyon wall.

lines.zh: 峡谷的石头，被我踩得响。
lines.en: The canyon stone crunches under me.
My fingers move at my side.
You didn't back off. Good.
There's only one way out of here.
And I'm in the middle of it.
How do you plan to get past?
A chip falls off my shell.
I give half a step, slowly.
That left my ears ringing.
I brace myself again.
Something inside has cracked.
No pain. Just heaviness.
Grit falls off me.
You hit quite accurately.
But this shell is thick.
I can take a few more.
That smell is strange in this canyon.
You hold it up. I don't understand.
I eat little and I'm not fussy.
Set it on the stone and I'll look.
Two steps back and I'll move.
Too soft, that thing.
I touch it with a finger.
I can't chew that.
Keep it for your own use.
In this canyon I'd rather have water.
You hit me and there's hardly a sound.
My shell is thick. It won't move.
You step back, hand shaking.
That knocked me slightly askew.
I turn and slowly make way.

lines.zh: 峡谷太窄，两个人过不去
lines.en: The canyon's too narrow for both of us.
You press along the wall.

lines.zh: 我侧过肩，从你旁边挤过。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and squeeze past.
Stones roll where we collided.
Stop pushing me forward.
There's only me in this canyon.
If you stay, stand by the wall.
I can't walk fast.
If you're leaving, I'll walk a stretch.
This wall blocks the wind.
Cold at night. Come closer.
My shell is hard. It gives no warmth.
But I can stand here indefinitely.
You sleep. I'll watch the mouth.
No one comes before dawn.
I bend, slowly.
I pinch it up with my fingers.

lines.zh: 石头一样的东西，我认得
lines.en: Stone-like things, I know them.
This can break things open.
You dropped it right at my feet.
I tuck it into a shell seam.
I don't take anything too heavy.
Useful things stay with me.
I could carry this one.
Tucked in a shell seam, I walk on.
You're in my path.
I never take a detour.
I spread my fingers out one by one.
This one will land solid.
The canyon's too narrow to dodge.
The wall is behind you.
Canyon stone cracks under my steps.
My shell blocks your retreat.
Raising a weapon won't help.

lines.zh: 我们的距离还够你走两步
lines.en: You have two steps of distance left.
After two, there'll be none.
I've raised my hand.
No rush. I move slowly.
But I will get there.
So it's now.
Stand right there and don't move.
I edge closer, bit by bit.
You retreat; I squeeze after.
My shadow climbs the wall.
Look back and your feet will slip.
The scree here is loose.
You take a step and slide half of it.

lines.zh: 岩壁把我的脚步弹回来。
lines.en: The canyon walls throw my footsteps back.
My breathing stays even.
You're against the wall now.
Any further back is stone.
The canyon is quiet — listen.
You're within reach now.
Listen. The canyon is very quiet.
Only the two of us.
I am coming over, do not leave.
I'm not waiting any longer.
Here and now. I begin.
Just like this. Don't dodge.
This step lands solidly.
You give ground slower than I take it.

lines.zh: 我的手拍在你的护甲上
lines.en: My hand lands on your armour.

lines.zh: 这一下把碎石都震起来了
lines.en: That shakes the loose stones up.
You fall back two steps into the wall.
My shell slams in, heavy.

lines.zh: 你的武器被我一掌压住
lines.en: One palm pins your weapon.
No flourish in that one.
You grab my fingers and can't hold.
My strength is slow, but great.
Your pauldron cracks audibly.
My hand comes up again.
The echo rolls a long time.
You're actually still standing.
Then hold out a little longer.
I don't mind being slow.
I've always been slow.
But I never stop.
You've reached the end of the wall.
There's no path ahead now.
This one settles it.
It's over here.
I come up from deep in the canyon.
That echo between the walls is me.
Only one or two of us come here.
Grit still clings to my shell.
Wind pours in at the canyon mouth.
Standing still, I look like rock.
Something has walked in.

lines.zh: 我把下巴从胸口抬起来
lines.en: I lift my chin off my chest.
It's very quiet here.
That's how I hear you.
I shift over, one foot at a time.
There's only one way out.
Flame bleaches my shell pale.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁摔下，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I fall from the wall and make a crater.
Water seeps into my seams and I can't breathe.
The blast throws me into the wall.
An arrow lodges in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 这力量透过壳打到里面
lines.en: That force goes through the shell to my insides.
Too starved to raise my hand easily.

lines.zh: 雷打在峡谷里，我浑身一僵
lines.en: Lightning strikes the canyon and I lock up.
There's no rock beneath me.
